faq.title: Moving forward, with a clear mind.
faq.subtitle: Short answers to the most common questions.

items.question: Is signing up paid?
items.answer: No. Creating your profile is free. You pay nothing to be visible to employers.

items.question: Do I need to already speak German?
items.answer: Not to get started. The level required depends on the trade, and you can keep improving while you complete your profile.

items.question: Who can view my profile?
items.answer: Only employers and centres registered on the platform, once you have made your profile visible. You can withdraw that visibility at any time.

items.question: How are skills verified?
items.answer: Your diplomas and certificates are attached to your profile, and your language level is estimated from a spoken recording. What is declared, attached and verified always stays clearly distinguished.

items.question: What is the role of training centres?
items.answer: They prepare your skills and your German level, and can show your progress directly on your profile.

items.question: How am I contacted?
items.answer: An interested employer must explicitly request your contact details; they are never shown in search results, and that request is recorded.
